parameters.query:
SELECT id, knowledge_type, insight, evidence_count, confidence, scope, source_campaigns, created_at
FROM marketing_memory 
WHERE knowledge_type = ANY(ARRAY[{{ $json.knowledge_required.map(k => "'" + k + "'").join(',') }}])
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY confidence DESC, created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, platform, content_type, impressions, clicks, ctr, conversions, roas, audience_segment, creative_angle, created_at
FROM campaign_performance 
WHERE (brand = '{{ $json.brand }}' OR '{{ $json.brand }}' = '') 
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
ORDER BY roas DESC, conversions DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT brand_name, knowledge_type, content, priority
FROM brand_knowledge 
WHERE brand_name = '{{ $json.brand }}' OR '{{ $json.brand }}' = ''
ORDER BY priority ASC, created_at DESC;
